site.name: Community
site.what: Share text and code with a link, comment, and follow what people on OpenVibe are making.

liveness.means: the process is up and answers HTTP; it checks nothing else (the database and dependencies are what ready checks)

shutdown.note: only the HTTP server is closed: the events outbox, the Discord relay, the Pulse subscriptions and the profile and search-document scans are not stopped and end with the process

resumes.what: unsent events in the outbox table go to OpenVibe.Events once the relay starts (at least once; Events dedupes by event_id)
the Roadmap space re-syncs from docs/roadmap/public.json; the community.profile and search-document scans start again from what changed

OpenVibe.Events redelivers network.block.changed and network.user.token_valid_after (and the Pulse subscriptions, re-created idempotently at boot) that were pending during the stop (at least once, deduped by event_id)

conditions: automatic: ovhost deploy puts the previous sha back and restarts again when the ready URL does not answer 2xx within ready.timeoutSeconds after the restart (exit 3)
rollback.window: automatic only while ovhost waits for readiness after the restart (30 s in host.example.json); manual afterwards, as long as no blocker applies

blockers.none: the schema code only adds (CREATE … IF NOT EXISTS, ADD COLUMN; no DROP, RENAME or table rebuild), which an older release ignores

leases.none: no claims: one process owns community.db (better-sqlite3, single writer)
